name: Quaddle
description: 开源桌面四足机器人套件，15分钟组装完成，支持无代码动作学习、语音AI控制和情绪表达，起价109美元，面向教育、创客和物理AI实验
description_en: Open-source desktop quadruped robot kit that assembles in 15 minutes, supports no-code trick learning, voice AI control, and mood expression, starting at $109, targeting education, makers, and physical AI experiments
why_matters: 通过109美元的超低价格和无代码教学界面，Quaddle解决了物理AI与机器人技术的可及性难题，让学生和创客无需嵌入式系统背景即可实际操作真实机器人，开放的OpenCat平台和ROS兼容性进一步降低了从教育到研究的技术门槛
why_matters_en: At $109 with no-code teaching interface, Quaddle solves physical AI accessibility by enabling students and makers to operate real robots without embedded systems expertise; open OpenCat platform and ROS compatibility further lower barriers from education to research
latest_news: Kickstarter众筹在前两天内达成5万美元目标，计划2026年12月初交付，创始人Dr. Rongzhong Li此前推出的Bittle在2020年Kickstarter上达成11倍众筹目标
latest_news_en: Kickstarter campaign reached $50,000 goal in first two days, targeting early December 2026 delivery; founder Dr. Rongzhong Li's prior robot Bittle achieved 11x its Kickstarter funding goal in 2020

evidence.quote: Founder Dr. Rongzhong Li built a robot cat as a personal project in 2016 while a physics lecturer at Wake Forest University, publishing the designs as OpenCat; he founded Petoi LLC in 2017 to commercialize it.
Starting at $109, it's the most accessible legged physical AI kit available — nothing else in this category comes close.

name: Mirror Particle
description: 构建从零开始的基础模型来模拟人类行为变化及其背后原因的AI引擎,为品牌提供消费者行为预测,专注于捕捉人类行为随时间的纵向变化数据和触发因素
description_en: Building a foundation model from scratch that simulates why humans do what they do and how human behavior changes over time, providing brands with an AI engine that predicts consumer behavior based on revealed behavior rather than self-reported data
why_matters: 与依赖大语言模型进行角色扮演的现有方法不同,Mirror Particle从视觉感知、空间推理和社会智能等维度建模人类认知,使用包含客户数据、时事、流行文化和社交媒体的专有数据组合来追踪动机如何随经历演变,不仅预测行为还提供背后的'为什么'
why_matters_en: Unlike status quo approaches that rely on LLMs prompted to role-play demographics, Mirror Particle models human cognition through visual perception, spatial reasoning, and social intelligence, tracking longitudinal behavior changes and providing the 'why' behind predictions with proprietary data combinations
latest_news: 两岁的旧金山初创公司已完成天使轮融资,即将完成首轮风险投资,并将参加2026年10月13-15日TechCrunch Disrupt的Startup Battlefield 200竞赛
latest_news_en: The two-year-old San Francisco startup has raised an angel round and is close to closing its first venture round, competing in Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on October 13-15
source_title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior | TechCrunch

evidence.quote: Originally from India, she ended up studying at the University of Toronto, where she became inspired by AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton's contributions to neural networks. After school, Ahuja ended up at Amazon Robotics building robots that build other robots.
